title: Count of Range Sum
description: Find the number of range sums that lie in [lower, upper]. A range sum S(i, j) is defined as the sum of elements between indices i and j inclusive.
pseudocode:
1. Compute prefix sums P[i]
2. Use merge sort on P
3. For each left half, count j in right half where lower <= P[j] - P[i] <= upper
4. Merge sorted halves

steps.note: Initialize prefix sums for nums [0, 0] with lower -1, upper 1
Count pairs: (0,1) sum 0, (0,2) sum 0, (1,2) sum 0. All 3 are in [-1, 1]
